description: Epic 36: in server mode the window loads this Mac's own web app (http://127.0.0.1:<web port>). It may listen to the shell's events (menu, deep links), read the app version, and read the permissions this Mac grants the server, open one of the allow-listed System Settings panes and mark the walkthrough seen (permissions.rs), and (Epic 46, bigscreen.rs) turn the window full screen and save Start in Big Screen, nothing else; the setup commands stay with the bundled app (build.rs).
